peer_statement: No concrete binding or shared-work gap found in final two files; independent read-only review, no additional execution claims.
checked_invariants: Every child receives a positive remaining shared grant and its separate hard ceiling; reported child work is debited before authority checks. No implicit reset to the original grant.
Catalogue and synthesis check result hashes are captured before servicing a deferred callback; final no-callback checks compare these retained hashes and the current certificate body/root.
Captured raw query is compared with the immutable stored request; effective method and policies are read again from the captured query, not pre-capture aliases.
Final strict JSON scans charge value/key visits and encoded bytes, enforce shape and byte bounds, and admit no later caller callback.

Whole job packet is hashed before the final publication callback and rehashed afterward; Store.put root must match. Final event metadata is detached from mutable returned result fields after the immutable blob is stored.
Final raw and persisted request hashes and fixed run identity are checked after the final forced control/deadline checkpoint.
No physical/native or service acceptance authority was added. Final tails do not assert atomic cross-thread/filesystem behavior.
execution_scope: Existing retained exact 106-case receipt and actual4/8 generation jobs only; this supplement adds no test count or native rerun.
